maddeler.e:
أقتوي (form VIII)
# أَقْتَوِي (ʔaqtawī) /ʔaq.ta.wiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# أَقْتَوِيَ (ʔaqtawiya) /ʔaq.ta.wi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
